brief.name: Gridlock Gardens
brief.pitch: Slide stone blocks to clear a path for a watering can robot as it reaches every flower bed in a calm, isometric garden.
mechanics: Drag stone blocks to slide them into position
Clear a route so the watering can robot can reach each flower bed
Hint system with 3 free hints per day
brief.art_style: Clean isometric low-poly gardens in pastel greens
facts: Players slide stone blocks to open a path for a watering can robot.
The goal is to guide the robot to every flower bed.
Players receive 3 free hints per day.
The art style is clean isometric low-poly with pastel greens.
The target audience is brain-teaser fans aged 25 to 45.
not_true: The game has no energy limits.
The game offers no real-money prizes.
Gridlock Gardens is a fictional product made for a portfolio demo, not a real release.
brief.launch_goal: Reach brain-teaser fans aged 25 to 45 with a calm, smart puzzle experience.
